description:
USE THIS TOOL WHEN searching UK parliamentary bills by keyword, session, house, or legislative stage.

Returns a paginated page of bill summaries (title, originating and current
house, current stage, whether it became an Act). AFTER calling, pass a bill_id into bills_get_bill for
full detail (sponsors, long title, Royal Assent date).

Authoritative source for UK parliamentary bill status.

house.description: Filter by originating house: the House the bill was introduced in, wherever it sits now. Omit (or 'All') for all houses.

limit.description: Maximum bills to return in this call. Default 20 keeps responses focused; raise up to 100 for bulk exports.

offset.description: Number of results to skip before this page. Default 0 for the first page. Re-call with offset=offset+returned while has_more is true to paginate.

query.description: Search term for bill titles and descriptions, e.g. 'online safety' or 'financial services'.

session.description: Numeric parliamentary session ID (e.g. 40 = 2024-25, 39 = 2023-24). NOT a year string like '2025'. If you only know the year, omit this and filter the results instead. Omit to search all sessions.

name: bills_search_bills

outputSchema.description:
One page of bill search results.

Wraps matching BillSummary records with search metadata so the LLM
client sees a real nested object on the wire, and can page through
large result sets.

bills.description: Matching bills. Use the integer `id` field from any bill to call bills_get_bill for full detail.

current_house.description: House where the bill currently sits

is_act.description: Whether the bill has received Royal Assent

originating_house.description: House where the bill was introduced (what the search `house` filter matches)

has_more.description: True if more results exist beyond this page. Re-call with offset=offset+returned to fetch the next page.

limit.description: Maximum results requested in this call

offset.description: Number of results skipped before this page

query.description: The search term that was used

returned.description: Number of results actually on this page

total.description: Total results matching the query across all pages, if the upstream API reported it. None if unknown.

title: Search Parliamentary Bills
